## Summary
Lenses checked: correctness, silent-failure, tests, comments.
The criterion hint should be fixed because following it produces input rejected by the supported `require_shall=True` option.

## Critical
(none)

## Important
- app/criteria.py:1 — correctness — With `require_shall=True`, a criterion following the new hint, such as `- Save the result`, is rejected. The hint requires writing “without the word shall,” while the validator requires `" shall "`; existing tests explicitly confirm this rejection. Make the hint conditional on the option or retain guidance compatible with both modes. — Users following the guidance cannot satisfy validation when `require_shall` is enabled.

## Suggestions
(none)

## Strengths
- The revised bullet-prefix hint matches the validator’s exact `- ` requirement.
- Existing tests cover acceptance and rejection of plain bullets under both validator modes.
